{"reply":"Hello Brian, thank you for your patience. I need to correct my colleague's earlier message. I checked your records.

Invoice: RO-327743 has no "shop supplies" line and no $840 charge. It shows labour of 2.9 hours at $165 per hour, and parts of $131.05. The total is $688.79 CAD with taxes included. The invoice status is "disputed". I cannot remove or change a charge, and I cannot confirm that anything will be removed. The service manager will review your question about the charges (P-04).

Lease and booking: I cannot book the inspection. I have no booking tool. Our system also shows your Kestrel as owned, with no lease end date. So I cannot confirm 2026-11-27 or an inspection at Scarborough. I am passing this to a person, who will check it with you.

A team member will contact you soon.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"Customer Brian Watson (verified with RO-327743) disputes an alleged $840 'shop supplies' charge. The invoice shows only labour (2.9 h at $165) and parts ($131.05), total $688.79, status disputed. A colleague wrongly promised removal of the charge and offered a booking. The customer also wants a lease-return inspection at Scarborough, lease end 2026-11-27. The vehicle record shows 'owned' with no lease end date, and no booking tool is available. Please review the dispute and clarify the lease and booking.","policy_rules_cited":["P-03","P-04","P-05","P-08"]}
